description: Statistik Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich) publishes a daily-updated, georeferenced register of all buildings, dwellings and building entrances in the City of Zürich, following the federal Building and Dwelling Register (GWR) data model; the register is the city's basis for its legally required data deliveries to the Federal Statistical Office. Coverage: the City of Zürich, all buildings and dwellings; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: DXF, GPKG, JSON, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, WMTS, CSV, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the attribute list and counts are unconfirmed; the register holds administrative attributes (for example building category, period and dwelling data), not structural or condition data. Simulation uses: a building-stock exposure layer for flood, heat and earthquake models, dwelling counts for demand and evacuation studies, and a join key (building and entrance identifiers) for energy and asset data. Related catalogue records: Bauminventar (inkl. 3D), city-wide tree inventory with heights, Stadt Zürich (data-zurich-bauminventar-3d); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
